Ben / Monica — forwarding customer report. Key points from initial repro: blank white page after redirect from accept endpoint; W-9 link returns 404 for that tenant. I grabbed these traces from the request logs:
- Accept flow: POST /invite/accept -> 302 to /portal/launch -> 200 with empty HTML body (content-length 0).
- Cookie header present: session=aa...; SameSite=None; Secure; path=/; domain=.redwood-prod.example
- Redirect occurs to subdomain tenant.craftsupplies.com -> browser shows blank screen.

Hypothesis: third-party cookie partitioning plus an iframe/redirect race (we see a truncated Set-Cookie on the cross-site transition). Also S3 object HEAD for the W-9 shows 403 (policy mismatch) which would produce a 404 on the signed link.

Actions proposed:
1) Ben — can you check the gateway edge rules for Set-Cookie truncation or header stripping on redirect chains? Prior incidents pointed to our edge CDN removing SameSite=None when moving across subdomains.
2) Monica — please prepare a manual one-time accept URL and a cleaned W-9 PDF to send to Elena if we can't patch quickly.
3) I'll reply to the customer with a workaround and request the browser/console logs if they can attach them.

Ticket: OPS-1289 (link below). I'm available to jump on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments: invite-html-snapshot.html

Subject: Re: Supplier portal — accept link opens blank page; W-9 download 404

Hi Elena — quick update and sorry again for the trouble.

What we found:
- Root cause (accept redirect): an edge rule on our CDN occasionally dropped the SameSite=None attribute during a 302-redirect to tenant subdomains. Certain browsers then treated the session cookie as a third-party cookie and refused to include it, leaving /portal/launch to render with no user context (blank page).
- Root cause (W-9 404): the signed S3 path was generated with an outdated bucket-policy prefix for a small subset of new tenants; the missing permission produced a 403 from S3 which surfaced as a 404 to the browser.

What we did: 
- Deployed an edge rule patch that preserves Set-Cookie headers across redirect chains (hotfix rolled at 00:45 UTC).
- Re-generated the W-9 with correct bucket policy and re-uploaded; link now resolves.

Workarounds while patching: I created a one-time accept link and attached a fixed W-9 PDF below. You should be able to complete the onboarding step now. If you still see issues, please try an incognito window or clear site data for tenant.craftsupplies.com.

Attached: W9_CraftSupplies-fixed.pdf

We also created ticket OPS-1289 to track the broader fix and a postmortem to be shared with affected customers.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Support Lead, Inference Operations
Redwood Inference
